base: (a) Property subject to the court's jurisdiction: probate property at its highest reported value, income, realized and unrealized gains, wrongful-death proceeds; (b) separately, non-probate property other than life insurance reportable for Oregon or federal estate tax (ORS 116.173(1)-(3)).

schedules.who: Personal representative commission on property subject to the court (ORS 116.173(3)(a))
schedules.capNote: Extraordinary services extra (ORS 116.173(4)); will provisions control (ORS 116.173(5)).

schedules.who: Commission on non-probate property reportable for estate tax (ORS 116.173(3)(b))
schedules.text: 1% of property not subject to the court's jurisdiction but reportable for Oregon or federal estate tax, excluding life insurance (ORS 116.173(3)(b)).
